title: Restart engine button in Settings: a model-folder change asks for a restart users cannot perform
description: MPI-800 dropped the /mpi/reload-extra-paths call (MpiNodes 1.2.13 removed the route), so a model-folder change now asks for an engine restart instead of applying live. The only restart control in the app is the dev-only Ctrl+Tab radial, so a shipped user is told to do something with no button for it. Surface _restartEngine in Settings, External Connections.
